test_name: Verify navigation to the 'API Documentation' section and download OpenAPI specification
description: This test validates that a user can navigate to the API Documentation section and successfully download the OpenAPI specification file.
steps: Click on the 'API docs by Redocly' link.
Ensure the page navigates to the API documentation section.
Locate the 'Download' button under the OpenAPI specification section.
Verify that the OpenAPI specification file starts downloading.
expected_results: User is navigated to the API documentation section.
OpenAPI specification file starts downloading successfully.
edge_cases: The 'API docs by Redocly' link is not visible or clickable.
The 'Download' button fails to trigger download.
The file is downloaded but is corrupted or incomplete.
Network interruptions prevent the file download.
Incorrect file format is downloaded instead of JSON.
data_requirements: Valid URL for the API documentation page.
Accessible and functional OpenAPI specification file hosted on the server.
User permissions to access the API documentation.
dependencies: Server hosting the OpenAPI specification file is operational.
No ad-blocking or script-blocking extensions interfering.
performance_metrics: Time taken for the OpenAPI specification file to start downloading.
Page load time for the API documentation section.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'API docs by Redocly' link is readable by screen readers.
Verify that the 'Download' button is keyboard-navigable.
Check for proper color contrast for the 'Download' button.
